# adds_site (Resource)

Manages an Active Directory replication site. Sites group domain controllers by network location and are assigned CIDR networks with `adds_subnet`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "adds_site" "headoffice" {
  name        = "HeadOffice"
  description = "Primary office and data center"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Replication site name. Changing it replaces the site.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Site description.

### Read-Only

- `distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of the replication site.
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier. Equals the site distinguished name.
